interpretation: The official build provides an application-side monochrome image adaptation setting. Use normal PNG resources and enable the setting. Do not add speculative theme/renderMode/isTemplate/adaptsMonochromeImage keys to the imported badge rules.
limits: Evidence is specific to the inspected macOS 1.1 build 24 and does not establish the version or behavior on the user's device.
The official description promises per-image black/white adaptation and preservation of colorful images, not selective recoloring of white lettering inside a colorful logo.
